snippet.title: The Infected - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Virus treatment caused unexpected DNA mutations that turned humans into Vambies, a vampire-zombie hybrid. The Infected is an open world sandbox survival game.

More about the game: https://gameoneer.com/the-infected/

Join Gameoneer Discord community for game news, discussions, co-op: https://discord.gg/WSjyznqKbk

Follow game news on Twitter: https://twitter.com/GameoneerGaming
